payload.summary: Implemented tasks 1.1 to 3.4: a tested audit table for four vendors and four lanes, a metadata-only observation script, a guide, and two corrected documents. Task 4.1 (host observation) is open.
completed_work: Research for the four vendors was dispatched to sub-agents; the rest ran inline in the sequential tier

decisions.title: Three verdicts, with silence recorded as unaddressed
decisions.rationale: Forcing silence into permitted or prohibited would invent a licence reading; unattended lanes that are not permitted name a keyed lane.

decisions.title: Quotes are marked raw or summarised
decisions.rationale: Some pages were reachable only through a summarising tool, and a paraphrase shown as a quotation is the error the Claude strategy note had already made.

decisions.title: The observation script never opens a credential file
decisions.rationale: Reading and then redacting can leak; lstat and listdir cannot. A test fails if the script calls open.
